name: sortable
title: Sortable
description: A list you reorder by dragging a handle with a mouse, a pen or a finger, or with the keyboard. The held item follows the pointer one to one, the others make room on a spring (FLIP) and it lands with the speed of your hand. Space or Enter picks an item up, the arrow keys move it, Escape cancels, and an assertive live region says each step.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)

.am-sortable-item.box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05), 0 calc(var(--am-sortable-lift, 0) * 12px) calc(var(--am-sortable-lift, 0) * 28px) calc(var(--am-sortable-lift, 0) * -10px) rgb(0 0 0 / calc(var(--am-sortable-lift, 0) * 0.3))

docs:
Sortable from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Sortable, SortableItem } from "@/components/ui/motion-sortable".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-sortable.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createSortable on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/sortable/sortable.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#sortable
